title: F1 - Ablation causale della regressione 39->35 e della scala stocastica (protocollo preregistrato, stage S1)

runtime.rollout_eval_sha256_pin_source: F0 receipts (rollout_eval.py `5433bcbc...`, re-hashed by the driver at launch)
runtime.isometry_rule: A_iso, B, C, D share env/reward/reset/physics/slew/OOB/terminations/starts: identical --config, identical CLI except --checkpoint/--seed/--action-selection/--output-dir and the A_iso driver flag.

sigma.structural_rule: pi.1.weight rows 2:4 == 0 and pi.1.bias[2:4] == float32(ln 0.005); detach() alone is not a freeze

A_ISO39_V3.restored_signals: 4/6 (healthy_knee/ankle_angle_imitation_target[_vel]); gait_phase_sin/cos remain as B sees them: (0,1)
A_ISO39_V3.limitation: A_iso measures the value of the 4 dropped targets under B's runtime; it does NOT restore the prescribed clock. A_iso differs from A_native also by slew 2.5/2.0 vs 0, reward ex_novo vs imitation, starts, terminations: A_native remains a non-isometric control.

A_ISO39_V3_S005.use: sigma-matched stochastic comparison with C and D

C.rule: C-det must be bit-identical to B-det

E.reuse: F0 JUL_H0 det/stoch jobs under v3_canonical

contrasts.drop: A_iso (det) vs B (det): isometric, measures the damage of the 4 dropped targets under the final runtime
contrasts.sigma: B-stoch-native vs C-stoch-0.005 paired by (start, seed) with common random numbers (same torch seed, identical architecture => identical standard-normal sequence; verified on step 1 and by rep2 bit-exactness)
contrasts.recoverability_offline: D vs C (== B mean) fidelity to the teacher on held-out trajectories
contrasts.recoverability_closed_loop: D vs B/C and fraction of A_iso (det); D-stoch-0.005 vs C-stoch-0.005 paired
contrasts.excluded: A_native vs anything isometric; E vs anything isometric (controls only)

dataset.obs35: actor_observation_vector_before (real env vectors, float32-cast for the student)
dataset.obs39: obs35 with the 4 targets inserted at 2:6; targets from the A_iso adapter trace of the same start (t_pre exact match) or the env-built reconstructor
dataset.teacher: V26_39D deterministic mean on obs39 (numpy float64 forward on float32-cast inputs)

refit.trainable: full mean network (encoder + pi.1 mean rows)
frozen: pi.1 log-std rows (buffers: weight 0, bias ln 0.005)
refit.loss: MSE(mean, teacher) + clip_weight * mean(relu(|mean|-1)^2) + anchor_weight * mean((p-p_init)^2)
refit.selection: fixed_final_epoch (no early stopping, no selection on validation or closed-loop)
refit.motivation: July adaptation: 400 epochs x 128 batch x lr 5e-5 on 24712 rows (~77k steps) reached val RMSE 0.0081; D has ~3000 training rows -> 300 x ~12 batches = ~3600 steps at lr 1e-4 is a deliberately minimal budget (recoverability test, not a bridge).

metrics.valid_cycles: summary phase_valid_cycle_count (v3-accepted chain HS->TO->HS), cross-checked with the trace last step
metrics.horizon_completed: end_reason == episode_time_limit and steps == env horizon (500)
metrics.teacher_rmse: sqrt(mean((mean_candidate(obs35) - teacher(obs39))^2)) over rows of the named split
metrics.negative_ankle: reported only (F2 requirement, not an F1 gate)

checks: every F1 job: receipt status ok, rc 0, summary.ok, trace present, SHA re-verified, closure pre == post == manifest
seeds used ⊆ {123,124,125}; sealed seeds absent from manifest and receipts
C-det trace SHA == B-det trace SHA at the 3 starts (sigma head does not change the deterministic mean)
F1 B-det trace SHA == F0 B0820_H0 det trace SHA at the 3 starts (cross-phase reproducibility)
PASSTHROUGH_B nominal trace SHA == F1 B-det nominal trace SHA (hook path inert)
A_iso jobs: projection_assert_count == steps; sidecar t_pre == [reset_time] + time[:-1]; env actor names == manifest35; inserted names == manifest39
reconstruction config keys equal between v26 native and v3 canonical configs (f1_common.TARGET_RECONSTRUCTION_KEYS)

adapter reconstruction vs F0 ctrl39 traces, two EXACT comparisons with no tolerance (instrumentation revision r3): (a) reconstruction cast to the env observation dtype read from the env (observation_space.dtype) == obs39[:,2:6] bit-for-bit at identical t_pre, all rows, 3 starts; (b) float64 reconstruction at the post-step times == the env's own imitation_target_q/qdot recorded in the same trace bit-for-bit; both max_abs_diff == 0.0; recorded values must be representable in the observation dtype; the raw float64-vs-recorded difference (float32 quantisation of the recording) is informational only
numpy teacher mean vs A_iso recorded raw action: max |diff| <= 1e-5 on all A_iso det steps

derived modules C, A_ISO39_V3_S005, D: log-std rows zero, bias float32 ln 0.005, entropy -7.758758 ± 1e-5 after reload; mean parameters of C == B and of A_ISO39_V3_S005 == V26 bit-exact; D clock columns zero
CRN: B-stoch vs C-stoch same seed: step-1 standard-normal draw identical (|z_B - z_C| <= 1e-5); B-stoch nominal seed123 rep2 bit-exact to rep1
dataset: per-trajectory split, train seeds {123,124}, val {125}, no overlap, rows == trace rows, arrays SHA in receipt
refit: epochs_run == 300, selection fixed_final_epoch, dagger_rounds 0, new_collection_after_fit false
G1_integrity.revision_note_r3: 2026-08-23 S2a: the r1/r2 wording compared a float64 reconstruction with the float32-recorded observation and could never be exact by construction (env observation dtype float32, half-ulp 2.38e-7 at |v| in [4,8)); the causal proof showed 6000/6000 cells bit-exact after the cast and 6000/6000 float64 post-step cells bit-exact. The projection contract (project39to35(obs39) == obs35 exact, bitwise) is unchanged.

primary.note: C mean == B mean (hard-drop error to the teacher); validation = seed 125 trajectories (3 starts)

secondary_informational.motivation: July adapted actor reached 0.0081 in-distribution; 0.02 is a loose off-policy bound, reported not gated

rules: sum over 3 det starts of valid_cycles >= 4
aiso_success_predicate.motivation: F0: A_native 3/2/2 cycles (7), horizon 3/3, knee ROM 1.00/1.00/0.88; JUL_H0 det under v3 3/2/0 (5), horizon 2/3, ROM 0.93/0.92/0.87; B 0/0/0, ROM 0.18/0.34/0.28. 0.6 rad sits between B's max and the July/V26 floor.
aiso_success_predicate.if_false: G3 = NOT_EVALUABLE_AISO_FAILED: the failure is NOT attributed to the drop; F2 must be redesigned (runtime/clock bootstrap), see plan.

D_vs_C_det.cycles: sum_cycles(D) >= max(1, ceil(0.5 * sum_cycles(A_iso))) and sum_cycles(D) > sum_cycles(C)
D_vs_C_det.knee_rom: >= 2 of 3 starts with knee_rom(D) >= knee_rom(C) + 0.5 * (knee_rom(A_iso) - knee_rom(C))
D_vs_C_det.safety: per start reserve_norm_max(D) <= 1.15 * max(reserve_norm_max(C), reserve_norm_max(A_iso)); end_reason != grf_penetration at >= 2 starts
D_vs_C_det.motivation: recovering half of the B->A_iso gap in cycles and ROM with a minimal off-policy refit is the minimum evidence that the hard-drop (not sigma, not the runtime) is the dominant, supervision-recoverable cause; less than that reopens the diagnosis before spending budget on a larger corpus (plan, Gate F1).

rules: mean horizon fraction (D) >= mean horizon fraction (C) over 9 paired jobs
D_vs_C_stoch.note: non-regression at sigma 0.005 with CRN pairing

report: paired (start,seed) deltas B-stoch-native vs C-stoch-0.005: horizon, cycles, return, clipped steps, penetration, reserve
A_native (F0 ctrl39) vs A_iso: runtime effect on the privileged actor

decision_rule: F1 PASS iff G1 PASS and G2 PASS and G3 PASS (with A_iso success predicate true). Any FAIL stops promotion to F2 bridge; A_iso predicate false => F2 redesign, not a drop attribution.
